services.name: Agentic Process Automation
services.description: Agent-based automation of back-office and operational processes, replacing brittle RPA and manual handoffs.
services.value_prop: We deploy agentic automation on top of existing systems, so throughput rises without a platform migration.

questions.text: Does the company publicly mention process optimization, cost reduction, operational efficiency, or automation initiatives?
Is the company hiring RPA developers, business analysts, automation engineers, AI specialists, or process excellence roles?
Has the company announced a digital transformation, systems modernization, ERP rollout or shared-services programme?
Is the company actively adopting or piloting AI, machine learning or generative AI in its operations?
Are there signs of high-volume manual back-office work, such as shared service centres, large operations or data-entry teams, or hiring for repetitive administrative roles?
Has the company appointed a new CIO, CTO, COO, Chief Digital Officer or Head of Transformation recently? New leaders buy new tooling.
Has the company raised funding, been acquired, announced an acquisition, or announced significant expansion that would free budget?
Is the company under visible cost or margin pressure, for example restructuring, layoffs, profit warnings or an announced efficiency programme?
Does the company already run a large in-house automation or AI centre of excellence that would build this itself rather than buy it?
Is this company itself an IT services, software development or digital consulting provider, and therefore a competitor rather than a client?

services.name: Cybersecurity Services
services.description: Managed detection and response, security engineering, compliance readiness and identity work.
services.value_prop: We stand up detection, response and compliance evidence fast, without the company having to hire a full security team.

questions.text: Has the company suffered a publicly reported security incident, data breach, ransomware attack or significant outage?
Is the company subject to or actively working towards a security or resilience regime such as NIS2, DORA, GDPR enforcement, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS?
Is the company hiring security roles such as CISO, SOC analyst, security engineer, IAM specialist, or GRC and compliance staff?
Is the company migrating to cloud infrastructure, adopting Kubernetes, or modernizing legacy systems in a way that widens its attack surface?
Does the company operate industrial, OT, IoT or connected-product environments that need specialist security?
Does the company handle regulated or sensitive personal data at scale, such as health, financial or payment data?
Does the company already run a large, mature internal security organisation with its own SOC?
Is this company itself a cybersecurity vendor or managed security service provider, and therefore a competitor rather than a client?
